changelog:
v0.5.0
- Automatically subscribe approved series to MediaForge AutoSync without changing existing jobs
- Add durable download receipts and conservative recovery after interrupted handoffs
- Add background queue/library synchronization, shared requests and per-user rules
- Add paginated admin overview, batch decisions, recovery actions and diagnostics
- Add persistent in-plugin notifications and daily episode digests
description: Searches the movie and TV sources enabled in MediaForge directly from Jellyfin. Users can request downloads; administrators can approve them or enable automatic mode.
name: MediaForge Requests
overview: MediaForge search and download requests for all Jellyfin users
